summary: Tested the carton-size (P×L×T cm) estimate feature in the backend and the UI, plus weight regression. Backend: 17 of 18 pytest tests pass (tests/test_pgs_iter43_dims_estimate.py). Working: dims summary (missing=6618), preview (6618 items, every dims value an int 1..500), apply with skip and override [40,30,20] (saved=5, dims_estimated=true), second apply returns 400, a weight preview id applied as dims returns 400 and the reverse also returns 400, unknown kind returns 404, list filters no_dims/estimated_dims with and without q, bulk dims_only_missing skips products that already have a size ('Sudah punya ukuran dus'), bulk without the flag overwrites and clears dims_estimated, invalid dims return 400, an Excel change to Panjang (cm) clears dims_estimated, and 0 product_events/price_history were created. Weight endpoints still work. The one failure is an estimate-rule quality issue (trolley speakers). Frontend (390px): dims banner counts, Tampilkan, Perkiraan otomatis dialog (an invalid '40x30' gets a red border and the count drops by 1, untick drops it by 1, Simpan 6.616 -> confirm -> saved 6.616, banner updates), row badges '⚠ Ukuran perkiraan P×L×T cm', select 2 rows -> Ukuran Dus dialog with 3 inputs (only-missing skips both with a reason; overwrite updates 2 and the badge disappears), and in the editor '⚠ Ukuran dus perkiraan' disappears after editing Panjang. Publish via the API with the edited length clears dims_estimated and creates 0 events. UI issue: the 3 dims inputs in the bulk dialog overflow the dialog on mobile. Estimate-rule issue: the 'Isi N Pcs' multiplier gives absurd cartons and weights.

minor.issue: The _DUS 'isi N' multiplier treats piece counts as items per carton: 'Amplop Lebaran Karakter/ Pack (Isi 40Pcs)' -> 85×68×51 cm and 120 kg; 'Tissue Greensoft Pop Up (Isi 60 Pcs) + Free Dispenser' -> Dispenser ×48 -> 127×127×363 cm and 384 kg; 'Roka Apollo Cokelat Ecer (Isi 50 Pcs)' -> 91×73×55 cm and 144 kg; 'Mesin Pengering Food Tray Isi 72' -> Kompor ×48 -> 164×145×55. 569 items get a multiplier: 7 have a side >150 cm and 27 weigh >50 kg. The owner confirms in bulk, so these would make shipping cost far too high. The same multiplier is also used for weight.

'Speaker Wooden Trolley WT8B/WT10B/WT6A Niko' match the small 'Speaker' rule (35×30×45, 4 kg) because the 'speaker\s*(trolley|...)' rule only matches when 'trolley' comes right after 'speaker'. 'Dispenser Kulkas 3/4 Liter' (a drink jar) matches 'Kulkas' (60×60×130, 35 kg). 'Stand Tower AC Portable' falls back to the generic size.

ui_bugs.issue: At 390px each Panjang/Lebar/Tinggi input is 174px wide in a 111px column (Input has minWidth 140 unless compact). The inputs overlap each other and Tinggi runs off the dialog's right edge (x 256->430, dialog ends at 374). Fix: pass `compact` to the 3 bulk-dim Inputs in bulk-dialog.tsx:94.
The validation error 'Isi panjang, lebar, dan tinggi 1–500 cm' stays visible after valid values are typed, until Terapkan is pressed again.

action_items: bulk-dialog.tsx:94: add `compact` to the bulk-dim Inputs so the 3 fields fit on mobile

weight_estimate._match: limit the 'isi N' multiplier. Ignore 'Isi N Pcs' piece counts, or cap the carton side and weight per category; at least do not multiply big appliances such as Dispenser or Kompor
NAME_RULES: match 'speaker ... trolley' anywhere in the name (e.g. r'speaker.*(trolley|meeting|portable)'); stop 'dispenser kulkas' (a drink jar) matching the Kulkas rule
Optional: clear the bulk-dialog error when the inputs change
critical_code_review_comments: Publish trusts the client-sent dims_estimated flag (to_product keeps f.dims_estimated when length_cm>0). The editor clears it on edit, but an API client could change the dims and keep the flag. Excel and bulk clear it on the server.
parseDims in weight-estimate-dialog silently clamps values >500 to 500 (e.g. '600x30x20' is saved as 500×30×20) instead of marking the field invalid
